subject: Tourism in Bihar
description: Eduteria Bihar Tathya Sangrah · Tourism in Bihar

questions.q: In which district of Bihar, the world's tallest (251 m) statue of Mother Sita will be constructed?
The Sikh pilgrimage site 'Takhat Sri Harimandir Ji Patna Sahib', considered the second holiest Takhat, is located at:
questions.source: Eduteria PYQ set — 70th BPSC Preliminary Exam (BH-EDU-005)

questions.q: The theme/slogan of the tourism department of Bihar is:
questions.explanation: The theme of Bihar's tourism department is 'Bihar Tourism: Blissful Bihar'.

questions.q: Which were the FIRST two sites of Bihar included in the UNESCO World Heritage list?

options.A: Mahabodhi Temple Complex (2002) and Nalanda Mahavihara (2016)
options.C: Sher Shah's tomb and Takht Patna Sahib

questions.answer_text: Mahabodhi Temple Complex (2002) and Nalanda Mahavihara (2016)
questions.explanation: The Mahabodhi Temple Complex, Bodh Gaya (2002) and the Nalanda Mahavihara Archaeological Site (2016) are Bihar's two UNESCO World Heritage sites.

questions.q: The world's tallest stone stupa in Bihar is built in the Buddha Samyak Darshan Museum at:
questions.explanation: The Buddha Samyak Darshan Museum (with India's highest stone stupa) is at Vaishali.

questions.q: A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Science City and Bapu Tower are located in which city?
questions.explanation: A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Science City, Bapu Tower and Bihar Animal Sciences University are located in Patna; Rajgir Sports Academy is at Rajgir.

questions.q: The holy birthplace of the 24th Tirthankara Mahavir Swami and the 12th Tirthankara Vasupujya are respectively at:
questions.explanation: Bihar is the birthplace of the 12th Tirthankara Vasupujya (Champapuri, near Bhagalpur) and the 24th Tirthankara Mahavir Swami (Vaishali).

questions.q: Which Sikh Takht in Bihar is considered the second holiest Takht of Sikhism?

options.A: Takht Shri Harimandir Ji Patna Sahib

questions.answer_text: Takht Shri Harimandir Ji Patna Sahib
questions.explanation: Takht Shri Harimandir Ji Patna Sahib (Shri Patna Sahib), the birthplace of Guru Gobind Singh, is considered the second holiest Takht of Sikhism.

questions.q: The famous Sonepur Mela, Asia's largest cattle fair, is held at the confluence of which rivers?
questions.explanation: The Sonepur Mela (Harihar Kshetra Mela) is held on the banks of the Gandak near its confluence with the Ganga at Sonepur.

questions.q: Bihar's Nalanda University was re-established at which place, with the academic session beginning in 2014?
questions.explanation: Under the Nalanda University Act 2010, the new Nalanda University was created at Rajgir, with academic sessions starting from 2014.

questions.q: Which circuit of Bihar tourism includes Bodh Gaya, Rajgir, Nalanda, Vaishali and Kesaria?
questions.explanation: The Buddhist Circuit covers the holy places of Buddhism in Bihar such as Bodh Gaya, Rajgir, Nalanda, Vaishali, Kesaria and Lauriya.

questions.q: The famous Mandar Hill, on which a fair is held on Makar Sankranti, is located in which district?
questions.explanation: Mandar Hill is in Banka district; the Mandar Mela is held there every year on Makar Sankranti.
